stance_rationale: The inherited covariance artifact itself is PSD and has acceptable condition number, but the current WT has no target alpha_scores, covariance, or weights.csv artifacts, so the risk package cannot verify the max-cash overlay change it is meant to critique. Several inherited diagnostics also trip RF-R4/RF-R5/RF-R3 and the method-shopping record contradicts the stated condition-number objective.

sigma_audit.method_selected: inherited ledoit_wolf_constant_correlation from stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260504_001/covariance.parquet; no target WT covariance artifact found

regime_sigma_audit.crisis_fallback_method: none; inherited regime_correlation uses Normal/HighRisk/Crowded/Extreme taxonomy and no populated bootstrap CI
regime_sigma_audit.comment: Daily inherited Extreme n=77 avoids RF-R8's n<30 trigger, but the current WT has no regime artifact, no switch-rate estimate, and no mapping to BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION/CRISIS.

crowding_audit.family_saturation_check: Semi+IT_HW 56% is L-219 elevated; package also reports MKT lower-tail dependence 0.6522 and style_cor 0.745, but no HHI or TDC-vs-PG2 active-book definition is supplied.

pit_c1_c15_audit.evidence: AR/R05 lag-1 is asserted, but current WT weights.csv and regime/cash schedule artifacts are absent, so vol_lag/dd_lag and overlay timing cannot be verified.
request.json asserts fresh regime_daily_v2 and macro lag rules, but risk_package_draft supplies no external-series lineage artifact for this WT.
No current WT covariance.parquet or factor-return calculation artifact exists; only an inherited WT-S20260504_001 covariance is referenced.
Current WT stage artifact directories qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260626_001 and stage_artifacts/WT_S20260626_001 are absent, blocking walk-forward schedule validation.

critical_concerns.description: Target WT artifacts are missing: no qepm/stage_artifacts/WT_WT-S20260626_001, no stage_artifacts/WT_S20260626_001, no current alpha_scores.parquet, no current covariance.parquet, and no qepm/mailbox/worktask/WT-S20260626_001/weights.csv. This makes the max-cash overlay schedule and current sigma/tail validation unverifiable.

The inherited risk tail already violates role red flags: ES95/CVaR95 is 12.89% versus the role default 2.5% cap, and GFC cumulative loss is 38.64%, above the RF-R4 25% single-stress-period threshold. The draft downplays this by citing MDD<45% and a looser ES threshold.

The inherited method-shopping log contradicts the stated selection_objective=condition_number: Gerber/RMT has lower cond 23.388 than Ledoit-Wolf 40.9539, yet Ledoit-Wolf is selected while the rationale says the minimum condition number among informative methods was selected.

Crowding and redundancy are not resolved: MKT lower-tail dependence is 0.6522, style_cor is reported as 0.745, and Semi+IT_HW family saturation is 56%. HHI and TDC vs PG2 active book are not actually supplied.

The risk package treats parent STR_1715 tail and covariance as sufficient for a changed overlay operator, but max-cash changes cash exposure exactly in co-activation states where drawdown behavior matters. Current overlay-conditioned MDD, stress, and CVaR are deferred to forge rather than measured here.

Regime validation is incomplete for the current WT: no BULL/NORMAL/CAUTION/CRISIS mapping, no regime switch-rate estimate, no target regime artifact, and inherited stress/state samples include thin monthly Extreme n=10 without bootstrap CI.
No risk_challenge_note.md exists; the available challenge_note.md is alpha-waiver specific. That leaves the risk role's No Silent Override response path underdocumented.

supporting_arguments: Inherited covariance.parquet was independently checked as 18x18, symmetric, PSD, min eigenvalue 0.0001571946, cond 40.95387, so RF-R2 and RF-R9 are not triggered on the inherited matrix.
Ledoit-Wolf shrinkage intensity is 0.0491, so this is not a full-shrinkage gamma=1.0 failure.
Hill alpha 2.2537 does not trigger RF-R6.
The draft is explicit that it computed no new sigma or numeric performance estimates, which is better than silently presenting inherited numbers as fresh measurements.
unresolved_disputes: Whether sizing_only inheritance can waive risk re-estimation when the requested change directly alters overlay cash exposure and tail behavior.
Whether forge will produce current WT weights.csv and A/B tail diagnostics before any final risk_package is accepted.
Whether the crowding metric is meant to be market lower-tail dependence, PG2 active-book TDC, sleeve HHI, or style correlation.
weakest_assumption: The most fragile claim is that STR_1715 inherited covariance and tail diagnostics remain decision-relevant for WT-S20260626_001 even though the max-cash overlay operator changes the time-series cash schedule and therefore the realized tail path.
rebuttal_required: Provide current WT weights.csv plus alpha_scores.parquet and covariance.parquet, or a risk-specific waiver explaining why each artifact is not required.
Reconcile the method-shopping contradiction where Gerber/RMT has lower condition number than the selected Ledoit-Wolf estimator.
Report current max-cash versus incumbent A/B CVaR, MDD, GFC stress, and co-activation drawdown, not only parent STR_1715 inherited tail values.
Provide HHI and TDC vs PG2 active-book definitions and values, plus style_cor evidence.

verification_triangulation.additional_perspective: The package is transparent about inheritance, but transparency is not enough: the current overlay schedule is the object under test and its risk artifacts are absent.

risk_specific_questions: If the overlay operator changes beta_AR * beta_R05 into min(beta_AR, beta_R05), what current WT evidence proves that stress-path cash exposure is still covered by the inherited STR_1715 tail file?
Why was Ledoit-Wolf selected under a condition_number objective when Gerber/RMT had a lower condition number in the inherited method-shopping log?
What exact metric is RF-R3 using here: HHI, TDC vs PG2 active book, family saturation, or style correlation?
